lines.text: Twenty-one of the sixty-one classified growths.
The reds ranked in eighteen fifty-five. Pauillac has eighteen.

lines.text: Mérignac, twenty-two kilometres south, gets nine hundred and twenty-five millimetres. Pauillac gets less.
